data.name: Princess Vs Zombies: Mermaid Curse
data.detailed_description:
What would you do if your world began to disappear?

Longing for adventure beyond her coral reef, the young mermaid Marina makes a dangerous bargain with a sea witch. While exploring ancient abyssal ruins, she awakens a forgotten artifact and accidentally unleashes the Mist—a dark force that erases fairy tales and transforms creatures into terrifying undead monsters.

After escaping the jaws of a gigantic Zombie Shark, Marina discovers a terrible truth: the Mist is spreading across the surface, and the only place capable of stopping it is the Castle of Stories.

👑 BRING FAIRY TALES TO LIFE

The Castle is under siege, and magic is its only defense.

Instead of building towers, you'll summon Echoes, magical manifestations of princesses, witches, and other legendary fairy tale characters, born from the stories preserved within the castle.

Collect Fairy Dust to summon your defenders and build the perfect strategy to hold back the invading hordes.

🌫️ FACE THE MIST

The Mist doesn't simply destroy kingdoms: it erases memories.

Its corruption constantly changes the battlefield, forcing you to adapt your strategy.

Hidden Horrors
The Mist can blanket the battlefield, obscuring your vision and concealing the undead lurking within the fog.

Corrupted Paths
Enemies attack from every direction. Corrupted merfolk and abyssal creatures surround the Castle, creating new tactical challenges in every battle.

🌊 EXPLORE A FORGOTTEN WORLD

Experience Marina's journey through a story of adventure, mystery, and self-discovery as she fights to preserve the world's last remaining fairy tales.

  • Explore the Coast in third-person.

  • Defend the gates of the Castle of Stories.

  • Escape the Labyrinth of Dreams.

  • Protect the Royal Halls, where the kingdom's memories are kept.

Will you preserve the stories before they fade into oblivion...

...or let the Mist erase them forever?

data.short_description: Join the little mermaid Marina on a quest to save the Castle of Stories from the dreadful Mist. Harness the magic of Fairy Dust to summon the memories of classic fairy tale characters, defeat corrupted creatures, and ensure that the world of fairy tales is not erased forever!
